facts.fact: Op-ed writer Moses Mugisha says Rwanda has no binding AI-specific obligation for developers or deployers, its five principles being policy commitments and not statutory duties.
Op-ed writer Moses Mugisha says Rwanda has no binding AI rules and calls for a standalone AI Act, with no draft mentioned.
The op-ed says Rwanda's 2023 National AI Policy, launched with Minister Paula Ingabire, rests on five ethical principles and gives roughly 70 per cent of its content to skills development.

systems.owner: Cabinet approved June 2026; not tied to the policy in the text
